contentSummary: news.html is the News / media listing page but it currently carries no real Sachdeva Group content. Its banner section is empty markup, its original "News &amp Media" heading plus an 8-tile image gallery sit commented out, and the only live block is a three-card "Latest News" grid whose copy, dates, alt text and two image paths are unmodified placeholders from a concert/Broadway/entertainment template ("Summer Festival Lineup Announced", "Record-Breaking Broadway Run", "Behind the Scenes: Making Magic"). Structurally it is a bare heading + 3-card grid: no H1, no intro copy, no filters, no pagination, no article links, no press-kit or media-contact block, and it does not load css/marine.css…
